clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Therzok waits for a promising rogue from Durotar. Kaplak has seen your skill with violence and stealth and sends you to the Cleft of Shadow to meet a Shattered Hand operative.

Kaplak draws promising young rogues aside when they begin making a name for themselves in Durotar. The new Horde honors Thrall, but not all its servants fight openly beneath his banner. Word of a fighter skilled in violence and stealth, willing to bend the rules of open warfare, reaches the underground guild in Orgrimmar.

Kaplak sends you beneath Orgrimmar's red stone cliffs to the Cleft of Shadow. Therzok waits in its gloom, out of sight of the city's grunts. There, lone cutpurses and ambushers are brought into the Shattered Hand, the Horde's covert network of daggers in the dark.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lower your voice, friend. Yeah, I know your name. Was told to keep an eye out for an orc by your description.
From what we've heard about you, you can handle yourself in combat, and aren't opposed to a little sneakery from time to time.
Anyways, you should go see Therzok in Orgrimmar. He's got an offer for you to hear.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, I'm glad Kaplak was able to get a hold of you.
We have some things to speak of, not the least of which is your future with the Hand.
